verdict.rationale: Appwrite's auth docs explicitly claim a capability to track which signed-in users are active right now and to broadcast online, typing, and viewing status in realtime. This is supported by its broader realtime event offering. That covers both presence and ephemeral status broadcast, but the evidence is a single product-page line. missing for 10: in-depth API docs for presence/broadcast channels, evidence of arbitrary custom ephemeral payloads beyond online/typing/viewing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
